explication: search2ai is a self-hosted, Perplexity-compatible search gateway: clients submit search, news, or crawl requests and receive normalized results with provider identity and fallback warnings. Its library core selects configured providers, retries along operation-specific chains, optionally enriches results with crawled content, and caches responses. Hono exposes HTTP and MCP interfaces; an optional legacy chat proxy injects gateway tools into OpenAI-compatible chat requests. Provider implementations and several HTTP/MCP relationships are shown in the supplied source index and excerpts; edges for documented but unsampled deployment capabilities are omitted.
